_comment: Inputs for splat-lab g1 (LGM). The Job downloads each file once into /data/in/g1/ and verifies sha256. `crop` is [x0, y0, x1, y1] in source pixels, applied before LGM's cut-out + re-centre step; `null` means use the file as-is. Licences recorded 2026-11-16 from the Commons file pages (imageinfo extmetadata).

inputs.note: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Founders Edition — the same GPU model as the one these splats were generated on.
